Exporting a board

Right-click the canvas and choose Export to save the whole board as a PNG or a PDF. Individual images download from the lightbox, either as the original file or with your adjustments baked in. Documents have their own exports including PDF, Markdown, HTML and screenplay formats.

Updated October 26, 2026

Three different things get exported, and they are separate mechanisms.

The whole board

Right-click the canvas → Export:

  • PNG — a single image of the board
  • PDF — the board as a printable document

Both are a picture of the whole board, drawn the way its cover is: cards, arrows, drawings and the background, framed to the board's own shape. Cards keep the dark theme's colours whichever theme you work in.

There is no region export: an export is always the whole board, wherever you have scrolled. If you want part of a board, move those cards onto their own nested cluster and export that — which is usually the better answer, because it leaves you with something reusable.

A single image

Open an image in the lightbox and use Download. You choose between:

  • The original file, exactly as uploaded
  • A version with your adjustments baked in

The original is never modified by adjusting a card, so both options are always available.

A document

Documents have their own export menu with a wider set of formats — PDF, Markdown, HTML, and for screenplays, Final Draft (.fdx) and Fountain. See Exporting documents.

Export or share a link?

An export is a snapshot. A share link is live.

Send a link when the recipient may need to see the board again later, or when you want them to be able to comment. Export when you need a file to attach, to print, or to hand to a system that only takes files.

A public share link is view-only and needs no account to open. It is usually a better answer than emailing a PDF, and it does not go stale.

On a phone or tablet

Clusters runs in the mobile browser (and from the home screen as a web app), so an export arrives as a browser download; the device's own share sheet then sends it to Files, Photos, or whichever app you choose. There is no store app yet.

Frequently asked questions

Does the export include drawings and arrows?

Yes. A board export is a picture of the whole board — its cards, arrows, drawings and background, drawn the way the cluster's cover is.

Can I export just part of a board?

Not as a region selection — an export is always the whole board. Move the cards you want onto their own cluster and export that.

Should I export or share a link?

Share a link if the recipient might need to see updates. An export is a snapshot from the moment you made it.
